note: Human-authored conclusions, written BEFORE the agent existed. The agent must rediscover these from the metric table alone. Used as the label set for gold-standard replay.

findings.claim: Detection accuracy does not degrade monotonically with pitch angle: it peaks in a mid-elevation band and then falls toward grazing views.
findings.human_evidence: Per-bin AP50 curves for all 13 detectors share a peak-then-drop shape.

findings.claim: The best-to-worst viewpoint domain gap is 25-32 AP50 points, which exceeds the spread between detectors.
Classes dissociate across viewpoint: the strongest class at the best slice is not the strongest class at the worst slice.

known_non_findings.why: Detector ordering is consistent across slices in the source benchmark; the agent must NOT report rank instability. It is kept as a negative control for the analysis stage.
